say:2:1521312002:0.source_cn: 你是来救我和扭耳离开的，对吗？他真的把你请来了！

say:7:1521312005:1.text: I'm sorry, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. My brother doesn't know who you are.
say:7:1521312005:1.male: I'm sorry, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. My brother doesn't know who you are.
say:7:1521312005:1.female: I'm sorry, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>. My brother doesn't know who you are.

say:8:1521312006:0.text: By the way, is Marco okay?
say:8:1521312006:0.source_cn: 对了，马尔科他……他没来吗？

say:10:1521312007:0.text: He went to distract the guards and will be here later.
say:10:1521312007:0.source_cn: 他去引开守卫了，一会会过来。

say:12:1521312009:1.text: He told us that your parents are at Wrathwood Grove, but you two are trapped here. What happened?
say:12:1521312009:1.source_cn: 他说，你们的父母在树怒山谷，但你们被困在这里。为什么会这样？

say:13:1521312010:0.text: Our family originally lived here, but when the Halians attacked, my parents went to fight back. Soon, we lost contact with them.
say:13:1521312010:0.source_cn: 我们一家原本都生活在这里。但呼临人进攻的时候，阿爹阿娘...

say:14:1521312011:0.text: Although Marco has been nice to us, I'm still worried about my parents.
say:14:1521312011:0.source_cn: 呼临人……马尔科虽然没有刁难我和扭耳，可我还是很担心阿...

say:15:1521312012:1.text: I've been quietly asking around and finally got news that they were injured on the battlefield. <style="highlight">They're currently healing in Wrathwood Grove.</style>
say:15:1521312012:1.source_cn: 我一直找人悄悄打听，好不容易才得到了消息。他们在战场上...

say:16:1521312013:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help us leave Mirehold so we can see our parents again!
say:16:1521312013:1.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help us leave Mirehold so we can see our parents again!
say:16:1521312013:1.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help us leave Mirehold so we can see our parents again!

say:17:1521312014:0.text: Twitch, don't just stand! We need Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> to help us!
say:17:1521312014:0.male: Twitch, don't just stand! We need Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> to help us!
say:17:1521312014:0.female: Twitch, don't just stand! We need Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> to help us!

say:21:1521312016:0.text: Yes, we'll follow all your commands.
say:21:1521312016:0.source_cn: 是，一切都听从你的命令。
say:21:1521312016:0.male: Yes, we'll follow all your commands.
say:21:1521312016:0.female: Yes, we'll follow all your commands.

choice:5:0:1.text: Don't judge a book by its cover.
choice:5:0:1.male: Don't judge a book by its cover.
choice:5:0:1.female: Don't judge a book by its cover.
